# Everything Simulated

> Gold Coast workshop that assembles turn-key racing simulators and crate-freights them Australia-wide. Compatibility is checked by a rules engine before deposit. Tickets stay in the customer app.

## What we sell

Turn-key Simagic / Trak Racer / Exodus / SIMRIG racing simulators, assembled and QA'd on the Gold Coast.

- Starter — from $11,260 + GST — https://everythingsimulated.com.au/prebuilds/starter
- Haptic — $18,999 + GST — https://everythingsimulated.com.au/prebuilds/haptic
- Motion (SIMRIG SR2) — $28,999 + GST — https://everythingsimulated.com.au/prebuilds/motion

## Hard compatibility facts (do not override)

- A build may only have one chassis, wheelbase, wheel, pedals, shifter, handbrake, motion, PC and seat.
- SIMRIG SR2 motion is Exodus XR1 only. TR120S + SR2 is blocked.
- Alpha EVO on TR120S needs the Simagic side-mount kit.
- Four-screen frames are XR1 only.
- Chat and AI may explain the checker. They cannot clear a block.

## Delivery

Every rig is assembled on the Gold Coast, photographed, then crate-freighted. Optional white-glove install in capital cities; SEQ install is standard. Lead time typically 3–6 weeks from deposit. 30% deposit (min $500), remainder on QA.

Cities: Gold Coast, Brisbane, Sunshine Coast, Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Adelaide, Canberra, Hobart, Darwin — https://everythingsimulated.com.au/au
